input_invariants: Use the complete current Founder prompt verbatim.
Load prior cross-references and applicable controls before drafting or execution.
Use the same complete source and control set in Python and GitHub.
Preserve relevant failed, superseded, rejected, historical, and corrective provenance.
hard_fail_conditions: Prompt is summarized, narrowed, or skimmed instead of preserved in full.
Python or GitHub occurs after a substantive conclusion instead of before it.
Python and GitHub receive materially different source or control sets.
Technical file checks are treated as proof of semantic, visual, or interface success.
A visual-display or editability claim is made without direct user-facing evidence.
A failed artifact is repackaged as compliant without explicit Founder authorization.
A completion claim is made before the actual requested work passes applicable controls.
Assistant execution failure is attributed to a tool.
sports_fleet_specific: Later substitute Sports Fleet boards are not edit-source authority.
Presentation or editability cannot pass unless the actual source is visibly open and usable to the Founder.
User-facing evidence of 'Couldn't load this file' means presentation/editability remains FAIL_OPEN.
closure_rule: Corrected work and Mirror Review must both pass Python and GitHub using the same complete source/control set; repeat until the second Mirror Review finds no remaining change.
